_doc: Exceptions for scripts/redesign/date-iso-guard.mjs (W0-8c, T0-32; decision 13). Every line under UI/ (src/@/components-dashboard/src/ui/src/components) that paints or builds a fixed date format today, matched by the text of the line, never by its number. count (default 1) is how many lines with that text the file has. W0-4a changes the Orders sites and trims this list; each wave removes its own. An entry that no longer matches exactly fails the test: remove it. Out of the list on purpose: C/ outside ui/ (contexts, utils, controllers) and src/pages, which no governed set reaches.
